short_description: Site-plan review at 50 units; state limits denial
answer: Local code provides discretionary site-plan review, but the HAA limits rejection of objectively compliant housing.
trigger: 50 or more dwellings triggers site-plan approval outside enumerated exemptions; Director decides, Area Planning Commission hears appeals.
date_evidence: Archived code dated January 2024, operative subsection annotations 2012-2019; 2021 HAA decision. Not a certified full 2022 snapshot.
scope_limit: Qualified permanent supportive housing has an exemption. Do not treat every LIHTC project as having ordinary site-plan review.

answer: No additional discretionary planning approval in the selected as-of-right route.
trigger: DOB checks compliance. Special permits, zoning amendments and public-land actions use different routes.
date_evidence: NYC 2018 official Zoning Handbook, printed page 25; 2022 continuity inferred, not a reconstructed legal history.
scope_limit: Member deference may act when zoning changes are required. This measure does not say how much land allows apartments as of right.

answer: State law limits subjective denial, while the state audit documents discretionary local practices inconsistent with that limit.
trigger: Local discretionary review can reach code-compliant housing; staff and Planning Commission roles vary with the authorization and review request.
date_evidence: 2023 HCD review studies 2014-2021 approvals; 2021 HAA decision. Retrospective evidence, not exact 2022 code.
scope_limit: SB 35 provides qualifying affordable projects a ministerial route. Legal protection and implementation must be separate fields.

answer: Design-review routes allow additional design conditions; qualifying affordable housing could opt out in 2022.
trigger: Full review uses Board recommendations and a Director decision; administrative review uses a Director decision. Thresholds vary by zone and size.
date_evidence: Full-review section last amended 2020; administrative section 2022; December 2022 ordinance documents the preceding affordable exemption.
scope_limit: At least 40% of units at <=60% AMI plus required rent restrictions and agreements; timely complete application needed. Exemption removes design review, not every other approval.
